🗺️ Moving from Mumbai to Pune, Bangalore or Delhi? Here's Your Complete Long-Distance Checklist!
Intercity moves are a different beast from local shifts — more distance, more planning, more things that can go wrong. Here's your 8-point checklist to make sure nothing gets missed! 👇

📅 1 — Book 2–3 Weeks in Advance
Long-distance slots fill much faster than local moves. Book early for the best rates and your preferred dates.
📦 2 — Declutter Before You Pack
Long-distance cost is based on weight & volume. Sell, donate or discard what you won't use — it can save you thousands.
🛡️ 3 — Always Take Transit Insurance (Non-negotiable!)
For 1,000+ km moves, full insurance is a must. A bump on the highway can happen — be protected.
🏷️ 4 — Label Every Box with Room & Destination City
Write "Kitchen – Bangalore" or "Bedroom – Delhi" on every box. Makes unpacking 10× faster when you arrive.
📍 5 — Confirm Delivery Address & Building Access
Check lift dimensions, truck parking & building permissions at your destination before move day — no last-minute surprises.
📞 6 — Update Aadhaar, Bank & GST Address
Intercity moves mean address updates — Aadhaar, bank account, PAN, driving licence & employer records. Start early!
📸 7 — Photograph Everything Before Loading
Document every piece of furniture & appliance before it goes on the truck. Essential if you ever need to file an insurance claim.
